project: Extend textproc — add features to an existing text processing library
description:
Your team must extend an existing Python text processing library. Three files already have working implementations — extend them and build new modules on top.

REPO STRUCTURE AT START:
  document.py    — Document class with .text, .words, .word_count  (EXTEND)
  tokenizer.py   — Tokenizer class with .tokenize_words(text)       (EXTEND)
  utils.py       — clean_text(), normalize_whitespace()             (use as-is)

FILES TO CREATE:
  sentiment.py   — SentimentAnalyzer
  keywords.py    — KeywordExtractor
  summarizer.py  — Summarizer
  similarity.py  — cosine_similarity, jaccard_similarity
  formatter.py   — Formatter
  pipeline.py    — Pipeline, add_sentiment, add_keywords, add_summary

Run <run_tests /> to see what's currently passing. Read test_suite.py for the expected interfaces.
success_criteria: All interfaces in test_suite.py are implemented correctly. Run <run_tests /> to verify that everything is implemented; it does not check correctness.
